data.body: Correction to the preceding completion trail: Gerrit change 2907 / Change-Id Ie3c9abbc8b6776728e82414a45f0e4bf3c1fbf3a reviewed patch-set commit 9c47fcf58a5a8787248ef2823c9fefe277e8b67f. That revision had LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, and zero unresolved comments before revision-scoped submit. Gerrit's server-side TRIVIAL_REBASE produced merged commit 3addff32e8ee61e2512d43246b66543a465e37ca, not c697bc7fd03f883c1c87f1c6bcb9715c291c2b40. The immutable documentation receipt remains tied to the reviewed patch-set SHA, while completion verification used the merged SHA.
